title: colorectal-nec-landmark-seer: reproducible analysis code for a SEER landmark study of conditional cancer mortality in distant-stage colorectal neuroendocrine carcinoma
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript Conditional one-year cancer mortality shows no early decline in distant-stage colorectal neuroendocrine carcinoma: a SEER landmark analysis with cross-tumor comparison (submitted to the International Journal of Cancer). The code rebuilds the study cohorts from SEER*Stat case-listing exports (SEER Research Data, 17 Registries, November 2025 submission), runs the landmark Aalen-Johansen, piecewise-exponential, smoothed-hazard, standardization and cross-tumor analyses (A01-A12), regenerates all figures, and checks the results against publication-safe reference results.

No SEER data are included. SEER data must be requested from the SEER Program under a Research Data Use Agreement; reference results are aggregate only, with demographic cells based on 1-4 patients suppressed as required by the agreement. A synthetic-data generator and a Google Colab/Jupyter notebook allow the pipeline to be run end to end.
